page.overview:
Who is Naorisa Cambral?

Naorisa Cambral is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Nothing is known about Naorisa's strength or abilities in the One Power. , Naorisa Cambral}}

She is elected as a Sitter in the Rebel Hall to replace Delana Mosalaine. She reswears the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod and proves that she is not Black Ajah. She is then part of the unanimous vote to attack the White Tower with their army.

After the reunification, she and Kwamesa Taramasu (the other Gray Sitter elected in the Rebel Hall) were no longer Sitters. Varilin Zanaire and Yukiri Haruna resumed the seats they had before the split with the seat formerly held by the Darkfriend sister Evanellein Lorn, being taken by Andaya Forae who was appointed by the Head Clerk of the Gray Ajah, Serancha Colvine.
